comment: main is not deployed by pushing to it.
Vercel's git integration deploys on push, which happens in parallel with the
checks rather than after them: a commit could be live before anything had said
whether it should be, and one was. It also missed two commits outright in a
single day, passing checks and never deploying, so production sat quietly
The deploy job in .github/workflows/checks.yml owns it now. It runs after both
check tiers, asks Vercel to build this exact commit from GitHub, and waits for
the answer, so a failed build turns the commit red. Previews on other branches
are untouched: only main is listed here.
If that job ever needs to be bypassed, `vercel --prod --yes` from a clean tree
still works and is how production was recovered the two times this broke.
